notes.title: Bylina | New Gameplay in Musical Trailer
notes.notes:
Greetings, Bogatyrs!

We are excited to share a brand-new look at Bylina — a musical gameplay trailer, offering a fresh glimpse into the Far Far Kingdom and the adventures that await.

This latest trailer not only highlights the mystical world and thrilling battles of Bylina but also showcases the impressive dance moves of Falconet, the game’s courageous hero.

[previewyoutube=v4OaVt8e5-E;full][/previewyoutube]

And before you ask - yes, Falconet will dance in the game as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246210/521deb4b9a6e4b02e15f142c8f49a086c24c9c59.gif[/img]

Bylina is currently in development and is set to launch this year on PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5, make sure to wishlist and follow the game here on Steam, so you don't miss any new info and updates we will be sharing soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2461440/Bylina/

notes.title: Slavic Folklore Comes to South Korea - Check Out the Bylina Demo at G-STAR 2024!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Bogatyrs!

An epic adventure awaits in Busan this week, as Bylina will be playable for the first time at G-STAR 2024, where you will be able to get hands-on with an early demo of the game, taking you on your first steps into a world inspired by Slavic myths and folktales.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246210/30b2c8b2db031e2341ead03ffc9d158d5924f95d.jpg[/img]

Taking place from November 14-17 in the Bexco Exhibition Centre in Busan, South Korea, G-STAR 2024 is a global game exhibition that celebrates and promotes the advancement of both the domestic and global games industry. 

Bylina, which will showcase its first-ever playable demo at the event, takes you on an epic journey to the Far Far Kingdom to challenge Koschei the Deathless to save your immortal soul and become a true hero. Take on the role of Falconet, a young bogatyr born without hero's powers, shunned and underestimated by almost everyone around him. Conquer numerous ordeals, overcome insurmountable odds, and become a legendary hero whose tales will be told for ages to come.

[previewyoutube=Af-MswMR5po;full][/previewyoutube]
Bylina will be found at G-STAR from November 14-17 in A-16 (BTC Exhibition Hall 2, F06
G-STAR Indie Showcase 2.0: Galaxy powered by Steam), where attendees will find a demo build showcasing the earliest moments of Falconet’s journey. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246210/7e6bca8619b9cf143f55f7f5e65fe5ab37006995.jpg[/img]

We look forward to meeting anyone and everyone attending the event, and we can't wait to hear what you think about the early demo. Whether you are coming to Busan or not however, make sure to wishlist and follow the game here on Steam, so you don't miss any new info and updates we will be sharing soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2461440/Bylina/
